Continuous small share issues (Appendix 2A plus secondary trading notices through Jul-Aug 2026) suggest ongoing at-the-market or option-exercise funding, partly offsetting it. A further capital raise before first concentrate sales is the likely path, and GLN has raised after halts in Sept 2024 and Jan 2026.

First lithium chloride concentrate sales and the 4 ktpa stabilised rate are guided for H2 2026. Winter weather put the plant temporarily on hold and cut evaporation (June quarterly). The first-sale announcement or a slip is the real catalyst and sits outside this one-session window.
